source: Already-used reply-search teacher training maps seed6280000..6280767, procedural_v2 Classic Generic 11x9 two-player, every fourth round
interpretation: Beneficial searched-response alternatives exist on most training maps but are rare among individual candidate pairs. Ordinary beneficial alternatives typically sacrifice initial static score and recover it through a favorable differential opponent response. A student trained to maximize overall pair sign accuracy can therefore look good while making harmful positive selections. Pair labels remain conditional native search scores, not terminal outcomes or complete-game strength.
decision: Use the existing maps only for a predeclared pairwise response-outcome experiment with a disjoint fit/calibration split. Keep previous validation, reserved selective validation and final complete-game seeds untouched; no rated or browser policy change.
